name: Ramp
text: Use a 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px white stroke at 70% opacity. This keeps the ring visible on any background while ensuring it doesn’t blend into light colors. The trade-off is slightly more CSS, but it guarantees keyboard users can always see where they are.

name: Reader
text: A 2px ring with a 1px white stroke at 70% opacity risks disappearing on dark backgrounds or high-contrast modes, failing WCAG 2.1 AA. A better alternative is a 3px ring with a 1px white stroke at 50% opacity—it’s more visible on both light and dark themes without adding bulk. Settle this by testing both rings at 100% and 400% zoom on light/dark modes and high-contrast Windows settings.
